_comment: Secrets (connection strings, JWKS URI in non-dev environments) are supplied via K8s Secret / X__Y__Z-style environment variables, never committed here. See appsettings.Development.json for real local-dev values.

ConnectionStrings._comment_UserDb: Set via ConnectionStrings__UserDb env var in non-dev environments.

Mongo._comment: Set via Mongo__ConnectionString / Mongo__DatabaseName env vars in non-dev environments.

Jwt._comment: Issuer/JwksUri point at kart-identity-service in every real environment.

Otlp._comment: Set via Observability__Otlp__Endpoint env var to enable OTLP export; empty = console-only Serilog + Prometheus scrape, no OTLP exporter.
